retake.retakeFee: Testing fee applies to each scheduled attempt

gdl.nightCurfew: No driving 11 p.m.-5 a.m. until age 18 (limited exceptions)
gdl.passengerLimits: First 6 months: only parents/legal guardian or a licensed driving instructor. Second 6 months: add immediate family members. No passengers under 20 outside these rules until age 18.

requiredDocuments: Proof of identity and date of birth (e.g. passport or birth certificate)
Two proofs of Connecticut residency (for REAL ID)
Certificate of completion for the CT Work Zone Safety Course
process.realIdNotes: A federally compliant REAL ID (Gold Star) requires proof of identity, one proof of Social Security Number, and two proofs of Connecticut residency. REAL ID is required to board domestic flights.
process.permitFee: $19 learner's permit plus a $40 testing fee (covers vision, knowledge, and one road test)
process.licenseFee: $84 new regular Class D driver license (includes the $40 testing fee; term varies by age)
process.visionStandard: 20/40 in at least one eye, with or without corrective lenses

facts.pointSuspensionThreshold: Warning notice at 6 points; suspension when 10 or more points accumulate within 24 months
facts.moveOverRule: Slow down and, when safe, move over one lane for stopped emergency, maintenance, and tow vehicles displaying flashing lights
facts.schoolZoneSpeed: As posted in marked school zones (commonly reduced, often 20 mph)

references.label: Take a knowledge and vision test
references.citation: CT DMV Knowledge and Vision Test
